method: Run 25 deterministic offline assertions against the complete lesson, metadata, DATA ledger and current Anthropic Agent Skills and OpenAI Skills official documentation. Review the provider-specific discovery and instruction message-role differences. No provider request, runtime integration, or historical model replay.

observations.trace: Anthropic documents metadata in system prompt and file-read instructions; OpenAI Responses API hosted shell places skill metadata and instructions in user-prompt context, while Agents API capability directories use separate discovery. Lesson preserves host authorization and historical evidence limits.

limitations: The offline assertions verify source-bounded lesson claims and metadata presence; they do not execute provider runtimes, measure selection quality/cost/latency, or verify production authorization.
Historical per-call requests/responses, exact model/endpoint, usage, task mapping and scorer remain unavailable.
